verdicts.claim: Official Mistral AI repos; org mistralai verified (isVerified=true, fullname Mistral, 83 models)
Public release 2025-12-02 (blog datePublished 2025-12-02T16:00:00Z; AA releaseDate 2025-12-02), inside the 2025-11-15..2026-11-15 window
Paper arXiv 2601.08584 dated 2026-01-13; describes Cascade Distillation (pruning plus distillation from Mistral Small 3.1)
License apache-2.0 (card tag), with only a third-party-rights clause; no gating

Params: 14B = 13.5B LM + 0.4B vision, API total 13,945,031,680; 8B = 8.4B LM + 0.4B vision, total 8,918,026,240; Instruct FP8 split 12.16B F8_E4M3 + 1.78B BF16 (14B) and 7.42B + 1.50B (8B); Reasoning pure BF16

Architecture: Mistral3ForConditionalGeneration, text ministral3; 14B 40 layers/5120/16384/32q/8kv/head_dim 128/vocab 131072; 8B 34 layers/4096/14336; sliding_window null; YaRN factor 16 over 16384 with llama_4_scaling_beta 0.1; rope_theta 1e9 (14B) / 1e6 (8B); Pixtral vision 24 layers hidden 1024
Context length 262144 tokens for all variants including Reasoning
verdicts.correction: Contested. config.json (max_position_embeddings 262144) and the card ('Supports a 256k context window') say 256k, but the vendor paper states 'context lengths up to 256k tokens (128k for reasoning models)'. The Reasoning variants' validated context may be 128k; this does not affect the 64k OpenCode target but the record should mark it contested.

summary: The identity and capability facts hold on raw reads. The repos are official mistralai (verified org), created on HF 2025-10-31 and announced 2025-12-02, inside the window. License apache-2.0, not gated. Parameter totals and FP8/BF16 splits match the HF API exactly, and every config.json value I checked matches (40/34 layers, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, all layers full attention, YaRN x16, rope_theta 1e9/1e6). The templates match the record: thinking is chosen by variant with no per-request kwarg, and the default THINK system prompt is injected only when the first message is not a system message. Tool format is [AVAILABLE_TOOLS]/[TOOL_CALLS]name[ARGS]/[TOOL_RESULTS] with no [CALL_ID], which matches llama.cpp b12418's Ministral 3 selector. Every benchmark number matches its source: vendor card and paper tables, Artificial Analysis embedded JSON (Terminal-Bench 2.1 9.7%/4.1%, tau2 27.2/26.6, and the rest), and the vLLM recipe GSM8K. Corrections: (1) Context is contested. The paper says 'up to 256k tokens (128k for reasoning models)', while config.json and the card say 256k for all variants. (2) The pass@16 setting for AIME/GPQA comes from the paper, not the cited README. (3) The gap that calls the -FP8 repo a 'recipe error' is wrong: the HF API 307-redirects it to the main Instruct repo. (4) The GGUF size_gb fields are inconsistent (8B rows give Q8_0, 14B rows give Q4_K_M). Not re-verified: the vLLM issue statuses (#53481, #48945, #66113, #55571 and others) and the cyankiwi/RedHat community checkpoint details. Raw files are in $SCRATCH/mv/.
